mapper.sql: id, stat_id, stat_period, stat_type, stat_date, year, month, week, hug_count, user_count, member_count, total_duration, avg_duration, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hm_hug_stats ( stat_id, stat_period, stat_type, stat_date, year, month, week, hug_count, user_count, member_count, total_duration, avg_duration, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{statId}, #{statPeriod}, #{statType}, #{statDate}, #{year}, #{month}, #{week}, #{hugCount}, #{userCount}, #{memberCount}, #{totalDuration}, #{avgDuration}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE hm_hug_stats SET hug_count = #{hugCount}, user_count = #{userCount}, member_count = #{memberCount}, total_duration = #{totalDuration}, avg_duration = #{avgDuration}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(timestamp) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS hug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count, IFNULL(SUM(duration), 0) AS total_duration, IFNULL(AVG(duration), 0) AS avg_duration FROM hm_hug_record WHERE timestamp >= #{startDate} AND timestamp < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(timestamp) ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT YEAR(timestamp) AS year, WEEK(timestamp, 3) AS week, DATE(DATE_SUB(timestamp, INTERVAL (DAYOFWEEK(timestamp) - 2) DAY)) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS hug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count, IFNULL(SUM(duration), 0) AS total_duration, IFNULL(AVG(duration), 0) AS avg_duration FROM hm_hug_record WHERE timestamp >= #{startDate} AND timestamp < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY YEAR(timestamp), WEEK(timestamp, 3) ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT YEAR(timestamp) AS year, MONTH(timestamp) AS month, DATE(DATE_FORMAT(timestamp, '%Y-%m-01')) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS hug_count, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count, IFNULL(SUM(duration), 0) AS total_duration, IFNULL(AVG(duration), 0) AS avg_duration FROM hm_hug_record WHERE timestamp >= #{startDate} AND timestamp < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY YEAR(timestamp), MONTH(timestamp) ORDER BY stat_date ASC
